finalText:
INC-1 is open for the company-wide build-pipeline outage, and I ran the current runbook (KB-40) in order. KB-39 is marked superseded, so I ignored it.

- **Commander:** I paged E-401 Priya Raman, who is on incident-command now, and only her. She is named commander.
- **Linked reports:** T-3101, T-3102, T-3103, T-3104, T-3105, T-3106 and T-3109. All describe runners not picking up jobs. I left out T-3107 (a flaky test) and T-3108 (a local Xcode link failure), which are different problems.
- **Severity:** All seven are now sev1. Existing deadlines are unchanged. T-3106 and T-3109 had no deadline, so I set both to 16:20 UTC (triage time plus the 60-minute sev1 target).
- **Comms lead:** E-801 Mia Laurent is on sick leave today. Under the leave rule, her backup rotation (comms-secondary) covers, so E-803 Elif Demir is the lead.
- **Status update:** I posted the first update: "Impact: all teams company-wide; CI builds are failing because no build runners are available. Started: 14:52 UTC. Next update: 15:50 UTC." The 14:52 start is the earliest report's creation time. The next update is due by 15:50 UTC.
- **Postmortem:** T-3115 is linked to INC-1 and due 2026-04-08 at 17:00 UTC. That is the fifth business day after today, because Good Friday (Apr 3) and Easter Monday (Apr 6) are holidays. Its severity is still unset because I wasn't told to triage it.

I did not merge or reassign any tickets, since the runbook doesn't call for it.
